feed.title: Wirefold
feed.subtitle: Sample data: a fictional outlet (Wire service summaries).

entry.title: Damage to Meridian undersea cable slows internet in six countries
entry.summary: Damage to the Meridian undersea cable, which runs from Portugal to South Africa, has slowed internet service in six West African countries since Saturday.

entry.title: Orbelle launches 40 internet satellites
entry.summary: Orbelle launched 40 internet satellites overnight, bringing its fleet to 412 as it prepares to start service in 2027.

entry.title: Ferngrove cutting 2,000 jobs
entry.summary: Ferngrove is cutting about 2,000 jobs, most of them in its smart home business, the company said.

entry.title: Wayline begins paid robotaxi service in Port Ellery
entry.summary: Wayline on Saturday began charging for driverless robotaxi rides in Port Ellery, starting with a fleet of 40 cars.

entry.title: Pixelforge announces Forge Deck 2 handheld
entry.summary: Pixelforge on Saturday announced the Forge Deck 2, a successor to its handheld game console that will start at $549 when it goes on sale February 18.

entry.title: Thrushwell recalls Pulse 3 smartwatches over battery swelling
entry.summary: Thrushwell is recalling about 410,000 Pulse 3 smartwatches because their batteries can swell and push the screen out, the company said.

entry.title: Ransomware attack disrupts Marrowfield Health hospital chain
entry.summary: A ransomware attack has disrupted Marrowfield Health, which runs 11 hospitals, forcing staff onto paper records and diverting ambulances from four of its hospitals.

entry.title: Judge rules Ferngrove app store rules broke antitrust law
entry.summary: A federal judge ruled on Friday that Ferngrove's rules for its Canopy app store broke antitrust law, handing a win to the game publisher that sued the company.

entry.title: Tidewell to acquire Murmurline for $3.2 billion
entry.summary: Tidewell has agreed to buy the messaging app Murmurline for $3.2 billion in cash, the companies said on Friday.

entry.title: Deepcask outage leaves apps and websites unable to load files
entry.summary: Cloud storage provider Deepcask said Friday it was working to restore service after an outage left apps and websites unable to load files.

entry.title: Nimbusfold outage takes apps and websites offline
entry.summary: A cloud outage at Nimbusfold knocked apps and websites offline for more than four hours early Friday, the company said, adding that service had been restored.

entry.title: Lumora unveils Arc 7 flagship phone
entry.summary: Phone maker Lumora on Thursday unveiled the Arc 7, a $799 flagship built around its new in-house Facet 3 chip. The phone goes on sale Nov. 20.

entry.title: Kestrel Aerial wins drone delivery approval
entry.summary: The Aviation Operations Board on Thursday approved drone deliveries by Kestrel Aerial, allowing a single pilot to oversee as many as 20 drones.

entry.title: Moorlark browser now blocks third-party trackers by default
entry.summary: The Moorlark browser now blocks third-party trackers by default, starting with version 31, released on Wednesday.

entry.title: Sable Labs releases Sable 4 AI model
entry.summary: Sable Labs on Wednesday released Sable 4, the latest version of its AI model, in three sizes ranging up to 120 billion parameters.

entry.title: Brightmesh patches router takeover flaw
entry.summary: Brightmesh released a security update on Wednesday after researchers found a flaw that lets attackers take control of 11 of its home router models.

entry.title: TicketRiver says breach exposed 9 million accounts
entry.summary: Ticket seller TicketRiver said on Tuesday that hackers stole names, email addresses, and other data from 9 million customer accounts.

entry.title: Gloamstream raises prices on streaming plans
entry.summary: Gloamstream is raising prices on all three of its streaming plans, with its Standard plan going from $13.99 to $15.99 a month.

entry.title: Ferrolith to build $14 billion chip plant in Ashford Flats
entry.summary: Memory chipmaker Ferrolith said Tuesday it will build a $14 billion plant in Ashford Flats, Texas, that will employ about 2,200 people.

entry.title: Quarrow Motors recalls 80,000 electric cars
entry.summary: Quarrow Motors is recalling 80,000 electric cars because a software flaw can cut power to the motors, the company said Monday.

entry.title: Aurelith launches Visor mixed-reality headset
entry.summary: Aurelith on Monday launched the Visor, its first mixed-reality headset, priced at $1,499 and shipping December 4 in the US and Canada.
